info.description: The Automatic Weather Stations API provides access to data from around 160 automatic measurement stations within the SwissMetNet network. It delivers vital meteorological data including temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and humidity every 10 minutes to support weather forecasting and environmental monitoring.
